notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Three distinct issues create repeating support questions and v0.2 design ambiguity. TeletexString intentional byte-exact behavior will generate 'why not normalize?' questions. Incomplete spec of which string types get full RFC 4518 in v0.2 will challenge PR reviewer. 'Legacy' framing contradicts planned v0.2 support.
Confidence: 75% chance of missed bug. Least confident: UniversalString edge cases may require deeper spec review (RFC 3629, RFC 4518 §4) to determine if surrogates/out-of-range handling is documented elsewhere. Running out of real complaints: no. Three engineering issues (opening motivation, spec completeness, edge cases) + one structural critique (rustdoc should not be internal debate forum) are all valid. TeletexString taxonomy and RFC citations are worth defending.
